messages.en:
{07 19 00}Grown-ups have to fill
their houses with grown-up
furniture.
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Täiskasvanud peavad oma
majad täiskasvanute
mööbliga täitma.

messages.en:
{07 1b 00}This place is still crammed
with weird odds and ends,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}I keep telling them that
they gotta start carrying 
nicer stuff, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}See koht on ikka veel täis
veidrat kribu-krabu,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Ma ütlen neile aina, et nad
peavad hakkama paremat 
kraami müüma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Hey!{01 00 00 14 00} You're not thinking of
buying something you don't
need, are you?!
{01 08 00}{07 02 00}RUN!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 15 00}Run far away...{01 00 00 0a 00}while
you still have a chance,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Hei!{01 00 00 14 00} Sa ei mõtle ju osta
midagi, mida sul vaja
pole, ega?!
{01 08 00}{07 02 00}JOOKSE!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 15 00}Jookse kaugele...{01 00 00 0a 00}kui
sul on veel võimalus,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
It's not like I'm actually
going to buy anything.

{07 11 00}I just like to mess with 
{ff 00 00 06}Nook {ff 00 00 00}and make him think I'm
interested, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Pole nii, nagu ma tegelikult
midagi ostaksin.

{07 11 00}Mulle lihtsalt meeldib 
{ff 00 00 06}Nooki {ff 00 00 00}narrida ja panna teda
arvama, et mind huvitab, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
Yikes.{01 00 00 0f 00} Where does {ff 00 00 06}Nook{ff 00 00 00} find
all this crazy furniture,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
Oih.{01 00 00 0f 00} Kust {ff 00 00 06}Nook{ff 00 00 00} küll selle
hullu mööbli leiab,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hitting up shops like this 
once in a while isn't so
bad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 19 00}It's a nice change of pace.
You can't {04 22 00}
all the time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Vahel sellistesse 
poodidesse põikamine pole
nii halb, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 19 00}See on mõnus vahelduseks.
Sa ei saa kogu aeg
{04 22 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 0b 00} Don'tcha think 
this place could use some 
customer-service training?
{07 17 00}I'm the customer. {01 00 00 05 00}I'm always
right.{01 00 00 05 00} Don't they
understand that?
{07 01 00}They could at least serve 
me some {04 18 00}
or something,{01 00 00 05 00} {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 0b 00} Kas sa ei arva, 
et see koht vajaks 
klienditeeninduse koolitust?
{07 17 00}Mina olen klient. {01 00 00 05 00}Mul on
alati õigus.{01 00 00 05 00} Kas nad ei
mõista seda?
{07 01 00}Nad võiksid mulle vähemalt 
pakkuda {04 18 00}
või midagi,{01 00 00 05 00} {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
